audit.why: 45.83% over 1809 games, HARD 8/10, matches the mirror (gwen__drmundo, 55.96% over 831 games). Percent-HP true damage on Snip Snip! plus on-hit scaling is the anti-tank profile; the lane is lost on items, not at level 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Gwen levels 1 through 4-5 and called both item stages even — the exact inverse of the truth and of its own prose (whys[0] says level 1 is yours; whys[5] and whys[6] say the item stages are hers).
audit.why: Level 1 Gwen has no Snip Snip! and no mist; the mid levels are close; her takeover is Nashor's-Riftmaker, not level 2. The mirror already corrected to Dr. Mundo / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen and both directions must agree.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Dr. Mundo / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Gwen / Gwen across win[] and phases[].side as one atomic group, ratings rescaled, and whys[1..4] plus phases[0],[1],[5],[6].why rewritten so the prose stops contradicting the row it sits on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist was described as blanket untargetability ('she's safe inside it', 'makes her untouchable while you flail') and given a fabricated 16s cooldown. Riot's text: she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist. Grievous Wounds against A Thousand Cuts was also never named despite it healing her off every auto.
audit.why: The counterplay is the opposite of what the page said — you walk into the mist and she is a normal target again. Mundo has no dash but he does not need one; it is a zone at his feet.
audit.corrected: Mist restated as 'only protects her from enemies outside it — step in or wait it out', real cooldown 22/21/20/19/18 used, and anti-heal timing added to spikes[2].

edits.before: Once Gwen has Q Snip Snip her final-snip % max-HP true damage eats straight through your tank build, and W Hallowed Mist makes her untouchable while you flail — E onto her only when her W is on cooldown.
edits.after: Once Gwen has Snip Snip! her final snip's % max-HP true damage eats through your tank build, and Hallowed Mist only shields her from enemies outside it — walk into the mist and she is targetable again.

edits.before: Gwen's Nashor's-Riftmaker spike shreds HP tanks with on-hit and % HP true damage; your armor is nearly worthless and she kites you inside Mist all day.
edits.after: Gwen's Nashor's-Riftmaker spike shreds HP tanks with on-hit and % HP true damage, and A Thousand Cuts heals her off you — bring Grievous Wounds to any long fight.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist (16s): matchup-defining — She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist (22s at rank 1, 18s maxed): it only blocks enemies outside it, so step in or wait it out. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track her Flash after any close call — it changes every dive.

edits.before: Track Gwen’s Hallowed Mist (16s): She’s safe inside it. Fight when down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 and only blocks enemies outside it — step into the mist or wait it out.

edits.before: Your worst level in the game — base stats lose every straight trade. Throw Infected Bonesaw from max range, last-hit, and conserve the health pool Gwen wants to chip.
edits.after: Your one clean window — Gwen has no Snip Snip! yet and no mist to hide in. Auto her when she steps up for a last hit, then bank the health pool she wants to chip later.

edits.before: Still Gwen's window. Heart Zapper absorbs a chunk of burst and pays it back — take only the trades where your W can cash its damage store.
edits.after: Even now. Heart Zapper absorbs a chunk of her snips and pays it back — take only the trades where your W can cash its stored damage.

edits.before: Heartsteel timing — every proc widens the HP gap and your cleavers start hurting. Stand in the wave and dare Gwen to trade into the regen.
edits.after: Her Nashor's timing beats your Heartsteel — on-hit true damage does not care how much HP you stacked. Stop duelling and farm your side of the wave.

edits.before: Warmog's makes you a raid boss: full HP between every fight. Gwen needs Grievous Wounds and a jungler to even slow you down — split, soak, win.
edits.after: Warmog's still leaves you food for percent-HP true damage. Never sidelane into her alone — soak with the team and let your front-line value pay instead.
